about.title: Global Transit and Transport Services
about.intro: Global Transit waxay isku xirtaa xamuulka u dhexeeya suuqyada adduunka iyo Bariga Afrika, iyadoo saldhigga hawlgalka ay ku leedahay Jabuuti. Waxay isku xirtaa dekado, wadooyin iyo macaamiisha si socod lagu kalsoon yahay.
about.cardText: Khibrad gaadiid, marinka iyo canshuur oo ku saleysan Jabuuti.
about.cardCheck: La wadaag lagu kalsoon yahay hawlgallada xamuulka gobolka iyo caalamiga ah.
about.missionP1: Fududeynta helitaanka suuqyada soo dejinta iyo dhoofinta Itoobiya iyo gobolka, adoo ilaalinaya silsiladda gaadiidka oo dhan.
about.missionP2: Waxaan isku dheellitirnaa nidaamyada canshuurta, marinka iyo macluumaadka si loo yareeyo dib u dhac iyo khataraha hawlgalka.
about.svcLogisticsText: Qabashada, kaydinta iyo isku xirka albaab ilaa albaab ee socodka soo dejinta/dhoofinta.
about.svcTransitText: Marinka badeecadaha wadada Jabuuti–Itoobiya oo leh raadraaca hawlgalka.
about.svcClearanceText: Hababka soo dejinta/dhoofinta iyo canshuurta dekedda Jabuuti.
about.svcCustomsText: Taageerada nidaamyada canshuurta iyo u hoggaansanaanta xeerarka.
about.svcDocsText: Raadraaca biilasha, shahaadooyinka iyo dukumiintiyada maamulka.
about.yousoufBio: Operation Manager at Global Transit, Yousouf Haroun leads day-to-day operations with rigorous field coordination and client focus.
about.moustafeBio: Finance Manager at Global Transit, Moustafe Warsama Omar oversees financial operations, budget control, and data reliability.
about.aboubakerBio: Assistant Manager at Global Transit, Aboubaker Helaf supports team coordination, operations follow-up, and service quality.
about.ibrahimTitle: Maareeyaha Guud, Global Transit and Transport Services
about.ibrahimMessageP1: Global Transit and Transport Services, himiladeennu waa inaan bixino xalal saadka oo lagu kalsoonaan karo, hufan, isla markaana xirfad leh, kuwaas oo isku xira ganacsiyada ku kala yaal Jabuuti, Bariga Afrika, iyo suuqyada caalamiga ah.
about.ibrahimMessageP2: Shirkaddeennu waxay ku dhisan tahay qiyam adag: kalsooni, wada-shaqeyn kooxeed, isgaarsiin, iyo heer sare oo hawlgal. Waxaan leenahay khibrad dhuleed oo xooggan oo ku saabsan transit, clearance, logistics, iyo habraacyada canshuuraha.
about.ibrahimMessageP3: Waxaan aaminsanahay in guusha saadka ay ku xirantahay qorsheyn sax ah, fulin degdeg ah, iyo xiriir macaamiil oo adag. Sidaas darteed waxaan si joogto ah u horumarinnaa habraacyadeenna iyo tayada adeegga.
about.ibrahimMessageP4: Anigoo ku hadlaya magaca Global Transit and Transport Services, waxaan u mahadcelinayaa macaamiisheena, la-hawlgalayaasheena, iyo xubnaha kooxdeena kalsoonida iyo wada-shaqeynta joogtada ah.
about.experienceText: {{years}} sano oo khibrad hawlgal ah transit-ka, saadka iyo kastamka marinka Jabuuti – Itoobiya.
about.asideMissionText: Bixinta xalal gaadiid oo lagu kalsoon yahay oo hufan ee socodkaaga u dhexeeya Yurub, Aasiya iyo Bariga Afrika, iyada oo loo marayo Jabuuti.
about.strengthsKicker: Ogow sida aan u taageerno ganacsigaaga
about.strengthsIntro: Koox khibrad leh, hawlgallo ammaan ah iyo xirfad buuxda oo marinka Jabuuti – Itoobiya ah. U hoggaansanaan, fulin degdeg ah iyo taageero gaar ah.
about.teamSubtitle: Koox khibrad u leh transit-ka, saadka iyo kastamka, si toos ah loogu heli karo WhatsApp ama iimayl.
about.teamAdminHint: Kooxdayada halkan ayaa lagu soo bandhigi doonaa dhawaan.

pres.title: Global Transit and Transport Services oo kooban
pres.p1: Xaruntiisu waa Jabuuti, Global Transit and Transport Services waa shirkad transit, gaadiid iyo saad oo ku takhasustay marinka Jabuuti – Itoobiya iyo Bariga Afrika.
pres.p2: Tan iyo {{year}}, waxaan taageernaa soo-dejiyeyaasha, dhoofiyeyaasha iyo shuraakada: kastamka, maareynta dukumentiyada, kaydinta iyo gaadiidka dhulka ama hab-badan oo ka bilaabma Dekedda Jabuuti ilaa meesha kama dambaysta ah.
pres.p3: Ballanqaadkayaga: hawlgallo la isku halleyn karo, daahfuran oo sharciga waafaqsan, iyo la socod joogto ah oo fayl kasta.
pres.corridorValue: Dekedda Jabuuti → Dire Dawa → Addis Ababa

highlights.processIntro: Laga bilaabo codsigaaga ugu horreeya ilaa gaarsiinta kama dambaysta ah, waxaan maareynaa tallaabo kasta oo ka mid ah hawlgalkaaga soo dejinta iyo dhoofinta.
highlights.step1Text: Waxaan falanqeynaa xamuulkaaga, meesha uu u socdo iyo waqtigaaga si aan kuugu soo jeedino xalka ugu fiican.
highlights.step2Text: Diyaarinta iyo hubinta dukumentiyada gaadiidka iyo habraacyada maamulka.
highlights.step3Text: Caddeyn iyo habraacyo kastam oo waafaqsan sharciga, soo dejinta iyo transit-ka labadaba.
highlights.step4Text: Gaadiid dhulka ama hab-badan oo ka bilaabma Dekedda Jabuuti ilaa Itoobiya iyo gobolka.
highlights.step5Text: La socod joogto ah iyo war-bixin joogto ah ilaa gaarsiinta kama dambaysta ah.
highlights.whyTitle: Shuraakadaada lagu kalsoonaan karo ee marinka Jabuuti – Itoobiya
highlights.whyIntro: Global Transit and Transport Services waxay taageertaa soo-dejiyeyaasha, dhoofiyeyaasha iyo shuraakada xalal la isku halleyn karo, daahfuran oo sharciga waafaqsan.
highlights.why1Text: Aqoon goob joog ah oo Dekedda Jabuuti, Dire Dawa iyo Addis Ababa ah.
highlights.why2Text: Habraacyo adag oo loogu talagalay hawlgallo ammaan ah oo aan lahayn lama filaan.
highlights.why3Text: Fulin degdeg ah iyo xiriir joogto ah inta hawlgalku socdo.
highlights.why4Text: {{years}} sano oo khibrad ah transit-ka, saadka iyo kastamka.
highlights.ctaTitle: Ma leedahay mashruuc soo dejin, dhoofin ama transit?
highlights.ctaText: Noogu warran xamuulkaaga: kooxdayadu waxay kuu soo jeedin doontaa xal ku habboon iyo qiimayn.
